messages.subject: Whitford — without prejudice offer + draft settlement agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Miriam,

Attached: (1) the without-prejudice offer letter we're sending to Daniel today, and (2) the first draft settlement agreement (v1) for his adviser. Opening position as agreed: £150k ex gratia (first £30k tax-free), PILON on the 12 months, £500+VAT fees contribution, agreed reference and announcement, open until 22 December.

We've pitched the ex gratia deliberately below your £190k ceiling to leave negotiating room.

Sarah

--
Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
sarah.whitfield@whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
